title: Unsafe Dill deserialization of TCP-server input enables RCE
fix: Defer architectural fix (replace Dill with whitelisted JSON schema). Quick-win: add module-level RCE warning, MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE cap on recv(), restrict listen address, document attack surface in SECURITY.md.
evidence: bandit B301; semgrep python.lang.security.deserialization.pickle.avoid-dill; agentic STIG/NIST review

title: Unsafe Dill deserialization of client-side network input (RCE on operator workstation)
fix: Defer architectural fix. Quick-win: cap recv() size, log unpickle attempts, document risk.

title: Unsafe Dill deserialization in RemoteAgent action loop
fix: Defer architectural fix. Quick-win: wrap loads() in narrowed exception, log unpickle attempts, size-cap recv.

title: Unsafe Dill/pickle deserialization in legacy fully-visible UI server/client
fix: Defer architectural fix. Quick-win: warn on import that module is for trusted-LAN-only research use.

title: TCP socket layer has no TLS and no client authentication (port 5050 plaintext)
fix: Defer architectural fix (add TLS 1.2+ wrap_socket and PSK or x509 client auth). Quick-win: document required network isolation in SECURITY.md.

title: Weak PRNG (random.randrange) used for SYN/ACK protocol nonces
fix: Replace with secrets.randbelow / secrets.randbits for protocol nonces.

title: urllib.request.urlopen(ident.me) has no timeout, allowing remote hang (DoS at boot)
fix: Add timeout=10 to urlopen calls; wrap in try with fallback to local-only operation.

title: Bare except: clauses swallow security-relevant errors (10 sites)
fix: Narrow to specific exception classes (socket.error, OSError, BlockingIOError) and log via logging module.
evidence: ruff E722; bandit B112; pylint bare-except

title: try/except/continue silently swallows errors with no logging (4 sites)
fix: Log exception before continue; do not silently swallow.

title: from _thread import * wildcard imports pollute namespace and obscure attack surface
recv() calls use ad-hoc buffer sizes (1024..1048576) without an explicit MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE constant or length-prefix validation before deserialization
fix: Introduce MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE = 1<<20 module constant and validate len(data) before pickle.loads().

title: No requirements.txt / pyproject.toml — supply chain dependency floors are undefined
fix: Add requirements.txt pinning minimum safe versions (dill>=0.3.8, numpy>=1.22).

title: No audit logging infrastructure — print() leaks data shapes/IPs/packet sizes to stdout with no severity, timestamp, or sink
fix: Defer architectural conversion of print() -> logging. Quick-win: add logging-based SECURITY logger module and use it for failed unpickle attempts and narrowed exceptions.

title: random module used for game decision-making (acceptable — annotate as game logic, not crypto)
fix: Add # nosec / explanatory comment noting non-security use of randomness.
evidence: SonarCloud python:S2245 hotspot (accepted as game RNG)

location: python:S100, python:S117 across src/ and test/ (~3500 sites)
title: Naming convention violations vs PEP 8 (PascalCase variables, camelCase functions)
fix: DEFERRED — repo STYLEGUIDE.md explicitly mandates PascalCase variables / camelCase functions. Document conflict in report; do not change.

title: No SECURITY.md, no published vulnerability-disclosure policy, no documented threat model for the TCP/Dill protocol
fix: Add SECURITY.md with attack surface, isolated-LAN deployment guidance, and reporting contact.

title: Latent ImportError: `from collections import Set` removed in Python 3.10+ — codebase is currently unimportable on any modern Python
fix: Switch to `from collections.abc import Set` per stdlib deprecation policy. Restores compatibility with Python 3.10+ runtimes.
evidence: runtime ImportError reproduced during compliance-suite collection
